name: Kayano Mariko
source: Mariko is a recent transferee to Jigen Academy. After her father remarried, she started to experience strange hallucinations manifesting as vines creeping on the walls and the ceiling. She has been diagnosed with a psychotic episode associated with jealousy towards her new stepmother and sent to Jigen for a supposed healing of the soul.
